info.title: New Runtime public JSON and MCP API
info.description: Typed OpenAPI 3.1 contract for New Runtime's free public JSON resources, MCP endpoint, moderated agent inbox, and optional x402 paid compute products. HTML, Markdown, text, and XML publication routes are documented separately in /openapi-route-catalog.json. Public static JSON reads enforce 120 requests per minute and return live RateLimit fields. Paid routes require no account or API key: the first unsigned POST validates and prepares the result, and only a sellable result returns HTTP 402. No public route can publish, approve, administer, deploy, or mutate site content.
info.x-guidance: Free: JSON routes, MCP, /agent-actions/contextualize.json for an outside URL, moderated /agent-inbox/* submissions. Paid (x402, USDC on Base, Solana and six more networks; no account): POST a JSON body to /agent-payments/primary-source ($0.10, the official source behind a post or claim; charged only when found), /agent-payments/rumor-check ($0.40, is this rumour independently discussed on X, and is there an official statement?), /agent-payments/research-bundle-v2 ($0.10, a research delta from the dated AI-engineering archive) or /agent-payments/prior-coverage ($0.05, has this URL, claim or topic been covered?). The unsigned request is free and returns a payable 402 quote only for a sellable result; pay one listed rail with an official x402 client and retry the identical body. Rails and prices: /agent-payments/payment-capabilities.

post.summary: Call the hosted read-only MCP endpoint
post.description: Streamable HTTP JSON-RPC endpoint. MCP 2026-07-28 is stateless, uses server/discover instead of initialize, and requires per-request protocol metadata plus mirrored HTTP headers. Handshake-era clients use initialize, which answers an unsupported requested version with 2025-11-25. Methods: resources/*, tools/*, prompts/*, ping; logging/setLevel and completion/complete are no-ops. JSON-RPC batches of up to 10 messages are accepted for 2025-03-26. Read-only tools plus moderated submit_* tools. POST /.well-known/mcp is the same endpoint.

parameters.name: MCP-Protocol-Version
parameters.description: Required for modern requests. Handshake initialize requests negotiate the version in the JSON-RPC body; subsequent handshake-era clients should send the negotiated version. For specification-compatible backwards compatibility, a missing header on a handshake-era request is interpreted as 2025-03-26.

parameters.name: Mcp-Method
parameters.description: Required for 2026-07-28 and must match the JSON-RPC method.

parameters.name: Mcp-Name
parameters.description: Required for 2026-07-28 resources/read and must match params.uri.

202.description: JSON-RPC notification accepted; no response body is returned.

400.description: Protocol version, metadata, mirrored-header, or JSON-RPC validation failure.

404.description: MCP 2026-07-28 request for a method that is not exposed (handshake-era requests get -32601 with HTTP 200).

406.description: Accept must include application/json and text/event-stream.

429.description: Enforced limit of 60 requests per minute per observed client address exceeded.

get.summary: Discover paid agent products and live payment rails
get.description: Canonical no-store catalog for current product IDs, prices, x402 version, fixed-price USDC rails, server-priced allowlisted token rails, direct native BNB/ETH/AVAX/POL/SOL rails, free preflight behavior, and replay. Read this route immediately before authorizing payment because capabilities can change independently of the static site build.

post.description: Current $0.10 product. known_stable_ids are part of request identity and exclude complete post/Signal twin clusters. Unsigned invalid or empty requests remain free; sellable results return an x402 402 quote.

post.summary: Buy research bundle v2 with an allowlisted non-USDC token
post.description: Settleable x402 v2 route. The unsigned request freezes the result, obtains a conservative dual-source price, and returns exactly one short-lived exact rail for the selected network and token. An official x402 client may sign that declared rail and retry the identical body; the result is released only after facilitator verify and settle succeed.

parameters.name: PAYMENT-SIGNATURE
parameters.description: Omit on the first request. On a paid retry, send the official x402 v2 encoded payment payload for one server-declared rail; never expose a private key to this service.

post.summary: Buy research bundle v2 with native BNB, ETH, AVAX, POL, or SOL
post.description: Settleable direct-mainnet route for popular native coins. The unsigned request freezes the result and returns one short-lived server-priced exact-direct rail. Broadcast the exact native transfer with the declared terms-hash data or memo, then retry the byte-identical body with an encoded PAYMENT-SIGNATURE payload whose payload.transaction is the chain transaction hash or signature. The server verifies recipient, amount, quote binding, transaction uniqueness, and finality before releasing the result. No private key is sent to New Runtime.

parameters.name: PAYMENT-SIGNATURE
parameters.description: Omit for preflight. After broadcasting the declared native transfer, encode the unchanged accepted rail and extensions plus payload.transaction. This exact-direct scheme uses the onchain transaction as payment proof and does not call the x402 facilitator.

parameters.name: asset
parameters.description: Server-allowlisted native coin and network pair. Read payment-capabilities immediately before use.

post.summary: Preview a server-priced non-USDC payment without signing
post.description: Non-payable preview. The server validates the same research request, obtains conservative dual-source market data, and returns an illustrative PaymentRequired shape. This preview cannot verify, settle, or move funds: PAYMENT-SIGNATURE and X-PAYMENT are rejected here. Use the sibling route without /quote-preview for settlement.

post.summary: Find the official primary source behind a post, article or claim
post.description: Give a post URL (X, Telegram), an article or page URL, and/or the claim text. The tool follows the post's links, then searches the web, and returns the organization's own page (announcement, paper, repo, docs) with an excerpt once it is readable. The unsigned request validates input for free; the tool runs after payment verification and the payment settles only when a source is found (not found returns 404, uncharged).

parameters.description: Omit on the first request. On a paid retry, send the official x402 v2 encoded payment payload for one server-declared rail; never expose a private key to this service.

post.summary: Check an AI-industry rumour against X discussion and official sources
post.description: Give the claim. The tool searches X (last 7 days, reposts and replies excluded) with a narrow query, counts independent authors and trusted voices (curated list or 100k+ followers), and looks for an official statement. Verdicts: official_source_found, corroborated, discussed_unconfirmed, no_discussion. The unsigned request validates input for free; the check runs after payment verification and settles when it completes.

site.name: New Runtime
site.description: New Runtime tracks the systems, signals, and shifts reshaping software as agents become first-class participants in work, products, and organizations.

x-newruntime.stability: Read-only static contract. Route patterns are stable; payload fields can expand with additive metadata.
x-newruntime.public_source_policy: Public routes expose only publishable source URLs. Private discovery feeds, newsletters, inbox rules, handoff files, drafts, credentials, and internal Telegram operations are intentionally excluded.
x-newruntime.mutation_policy: External systems cannot modify the site through public routes. Only owner-approved internal workflows may create, edit, publish, deploy, or delete content.

deprecation_policy.deprecation_header: Deprecation (RFC 9745 structured date), only when scheduled
deprecation_policy.sunset_header: Sunset (RFC 8594 HTTP-date), only when removal is scheduled

moderated_submissions.policy: Queued for weekly review; never change the site directly.
